definitions.ask: Should the storm-hotfix phase propose a gated global reinstall as soon as it lands?
definitions.why: The live TUI runs a storm-capable build; one approval stops the storm before the epic lands

definitions.ask: How should the trust-root fix treat acknowledgments recorded under the old `<repo>/sase` key?
definitions.why: One legacy ack exists; fail-closed until one re-ack, after which every workspace inherits it

choices.label: Drop the old key; you re-run `sase config trust allow` once in the primary checkout
Honor old-key acks behind a sunset flag; adds a flag bead and a legacy-digest trust path
